notes.title: Phat Phrog Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26675641/1394bd309d1574e1da7e2a0e9c4f542d7d01268b.png[/img]

I've decided to change Phat Phrog from free to play to pay to play from Feb 1st 2023, the game will remain free for people who have previously downloaded the game 

Also in Q3 - Q4 2023 i will be updating Phat Phrog to have a landscape view and also have talents for each of the Phrogs that makes them unique and gives the player more control over the Phrogs including a slam skill that brings the phrogs down like a lead balloon so you can hit those logs easier

There's lot's planned for Phat Phrog in 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26675641/0e3533d21686d1013c933aaa9731e7e89af3ad14.png[/img]

notes.title: Phat Pigments Update
notes.content:
A new update has been applied to Phat Phrog, this update adds 8 pigments that can be unlocked from treasure chests in Phat Phrog, these pigments change the colour of Phlam and add another collectible element to the game

You can access the Pigments page by clicking the icon in the top right hand corner on the Main Menu

Also achievements should be working now

Thanks

Lee!
